data.one_liner: Scrapes a website for favicons and orders them by image dimensions.
data.what_it_does: Library for finding favicons in a website, either in a <link> tag or by a predefined URL. It validates ICO file signatures, filters file extensions, and sorts the output based on image dimensions.
use_when: You need to fetch and extract favicon icons from a given website URL.
You want to find the best-sized favicon automatically for a web clip or bookmark feature.
avoid_when: You need to render or cache the fetched images extensively in the UI.
You require complex local storage or caching of scraped web assets.
strengths: Automatically sorts and selects the best favicon based on image dimensions.
Validates ICO file signatures and handles relative URLs correctly.
weaknesses: Depends entirely on successful web scraping and HTTP responses from target sites.
Limited to favicon detection and retrieval features.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic HTTP GET requests without specialized favicon HTML parsing.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need advanced HTTP client features like interceptors and global configuration.
